subject: MAP: POC access — API key operator checklist & IP stamp for VPC peering
summary: Mutual action plan alignment for POC environment setup. Covers operator roles for API keys, org seed, IP allowlist stamping, and VPC peering window with a target close by end of March. Action owners assigned and next checkpoints scheduled.
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cardioinc.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@cardioinc.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — verifying initial access items

Neha / Jonas,

Thanks for the MAP deck this morning. Quick clarification items from our infra team so we can lock in the POC window: 

- We need a concise list of operator roles that will manage API keys during the trial (who can mint ephemeral keys, who can rotate, and who has read-only visibility).
- For the IP allowlist we prefer a CIDR stamp that we can hand to our networking team rather than a long list of hosts — can Redwood provide a single stampable prefix per region?
- VPC peering: availability window ideally the week of Mar 20 — can you confirm a 2-hour maintenance window for peering handshake?

Attached a short internal checklist so you can see their gating items.

-Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
CTO, CardioInc
liam.oconnor@cardioinc.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cardioinc.com>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@cardioinc.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — verifying initial access items

Hi Liam — thanks for the note. Short answers here and a proposed next step.

1) API key operator roles (proposed):
   - Key Admin (can create/rotate/revoke keys, full audit): neha_kapoor (Redwood) + rachel_kim (Redwood)
   - Key Operator (can mint ephemeral seeds for your test accounts): jonas_weber (Redwood)
   - Key Auditor (read-only, view usage and logs): ben_carter (Redwood) + CardioInc security contact (Sofia)

2) IP allowlist "stamp": we can provide a single regional CIDR /27 for the US-west trial and a /27 for US-east if you need both. We will also publish a short TTLed DNS name (allowed.redwood-inference.net/us-west) you can resolve to confirm the current set during the POC.

3) VPC peering maintenance window: we can reserve Mar 21 02:00-04:00 PT for the handshake and validation. That gives your team time to smoke-test. If you need a daytime slot we can shift but this slot is currently open.

Next step: I'll attach an API-key operator checklist and a MAP checkpoint matrix. Can the CardioInc infra lead confirm acceptance of the CIDR approach and the Mar 21 window?

Thanks,
Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@cardioinc.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, liam.oconnor@cardioinc.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — verifying initial access items

Neha — quick confirmation from our side: 

- CIDR stamp acceptance: Confirmed. US-west /27 is fine (we'll apply to the staging VPC).
- VPC peering window: Mar 21 02:00-04:00 PT accepted. We'll have a networking engineer on-call for rollback.
- Operator roles: we need the Key Auditor to be able to download a daily audit CSV for the POC; is that exposed in the console or via an API?

If you can provide the sample audit CSV and the API-key operator checklist I can route to procurement for the MSA addendum.

Thanks — Sofia

--
Sofia Ramirez
Infra Lead, CardioInc

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@cardioinc.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 11:54:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — verifying initial access items

Sofia — good questions. A few clarifications and the plan for deliverables: 

- Audit CSV: yes — Key Auditor role can export daily audit records. We'll provide an example CSV (see attachment) and an API endpoint for programmatic retrieval during the POC.
- Operator checklist: attached is a short md doc that describes the allowed operations per role and the ephemeral key flow. Key details:
   * Ephemeral seeds TTL: default 1 hour (configurable up to 8 hours for POC)
   * Minting API requires Key Operator credentials + one-time nonce from CardioInc account to bind requests to your org
   * Rotation path: Key Admin rotates via console or API; rotation logs are immutable and appear in daily CSV.
- Org setup: we'll create a CardioInc test org and seed two service users (cardio-staging-ops, cardio-ci-test). Please confirm preferred service user names and an org slug.

Deliverables by Tue Feb 22:
  - api-key-operator-roles-v1.md (attached)
  - example-audit-export-20280220.csv (attached)
  - MAP checkpoint matrix (spreadsheet link)

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Platform Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: liam.oconnor@cardioinc.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, sofia.ramirez@cardioinc.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Feb 2028 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — verifying initial access items

Appreciate the fast turnaround team — CardioInc aligns on the POC plan and the MAP checkpoints. A couple of final items before we formally sign the MAP: 

- Please lock the org slug as cardioinc-trial and seed the two users as proposed (cardio-staging-ops, cardio-ci-test).
- Confirm per-day audit export retention for the POC (we need 30 days retained).
- For the VPC peering slot: we'll publish the change window to our incident calendar. If everything is green after the handshake we'll consider Mar 22 for the first functional tests.

If you can confirm the above and upload the MAP checkpoint matrix to the shared Drive link I'll route the MAP to procurement for signature (deal CINC-43921).

-Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
CTO, CardioInc
